title: Integral natural scalar morphism and its two invertible outer factors
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite-field datum $D$ with $\ell\ne D.p$, finite-type schemes $X,Y$ over $D.k$, a separated finite-type relative morphism $f:X\to Y$, its compactification $c$, a coefficient construction $P$, and a specified StageAction [def-sf-locally-finite-adic-compact-support-data, def-sf-constructible-exceptional-coefficient-construction-data, def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Fix realizations source and target of $X,Y$ [def-sf-locally-finite-adic-realization-data] and a family of completed-to-native Changes whose maps at $X,Y$ equal their integral realization maps [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. For each finite unlifted coefficient index $E$ there is a natural MORPHISM between the two finite-stage compact-support functors after precomposition with integral-to-rational localization. For each integral finite-Tor input $K$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], its image through the native section equivalence is $b_K\,\beta_K\,d_K$, with $b_K,d_K$ isomorphisms and $\beta_K$ precisely PurCompactSupport.comparison(change E,c) at $K$. It also satisfies IntegralComponent: the original six-arrow IntegralNormalization formula at this input, with its proper/open scalar mate unchanged. No invertibility of $\beta_K$ or of the natural morphism and no rational-arrow or field-transition naturality are asserted.

theorem native_integral_scalar_morphism [G : NativeGeometry.{u} l]
    (source : Realization l X) (target : Realization l Y)
    (stage : StageAction l D hl P c)
    (change : ∀ E : Index l (PadicAlgCl l),
      PurCompactSupport.Change (PurCompactSupport.completed l
        (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E)) (nativeCoefficients l))
    (hs : ∀ E, (change E).map X = (source.coefficient E).integralMap l X)
    (ht : ∀ E, (change E).map Y = (target.coefficient E).integralMap l Y)
    (E : Index l (PadicAlgCl l)) :
    ∃ tau : sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X ⋙
        finiteSource l D hl P c target stage E ⟶
      sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X ⋙
        finiteTarget l c source E,
      ∀ K : finiteTorConstructibleIntegralCategory l (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X,
        (∃ (b : (sections l Y).mapDerivedCategory.obj
              ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l
                (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X ⋙
                finiteSource l D hl P c target stage E).obj
                  ((PurCompactSupport.finiteTorIntegralInclusion l
                    (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X).obj K)) ≅
            (PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.completed l
              (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E)) c ⋙
              pbcDerivedExtend ((change E).map Y)).obj K.obj)
          (d : (pbcDerivedExtend ((change E).map X) ⋙
              PurCompactSupport.image (nativeCoefficients l) c).obj K.obj ≅
            (sections l Y).mapDerivedCategory.obj
              ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l
                (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X ⋙
                finiteTarget l c source E).obj
                  ((PurCompactSupport.finiteTorIntegralInclusion l
                    (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X).obj K))),
          (sections l Y).mapDerivedCategory.map
              (tau.app ((PurCompactSupport.finiteTorIntegralInclusion l
                (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X).obj K)) =
            b.hom ≫ (PurCompactSupport.comparison (change E) c).app K.obj ≫ d.hom) ∧
        IntegralComponent l D hl P c source target change E K
          (tau.app ((PurCompactSupport.finiteTorIntegralInclusion l
            (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X).obj K))
